products.name: Leasing of Open-Air Retail Shopping Centers
products.description: Brixmor owns and operates a large portfolio of open-air retail shopping centers, primarily grocery-anchored, which are leased to a diverse mix of national, regional, and local retailers and service providers. This business requires physical ownership, management, and leasing of real estate assets across the U.S.

products.name: Repositioning and Redevelopment of Retail Properties
products.description: Brixmor invests capital in the repositioning and redevelopment of existing shopping centers, including anchor space repositioning and outparcel development, to enhance property value and attract high-quality tenants. This involves construction, renovation, and tenant-driven upgrades to physical assets.

products.name: Property Acquisition and Disposition Services
products.description: Brixmor acquires and sells retail real estate assets, including open-air shopping centers and non-owned anchor spaces or outparcels, to optimize its portfolio and concentrate holdings in attractive markets. This involves real estate transaction expertise and capital deployment.

products.name: Cigarettes
products.description: Combustible cigarettes are manufactured primarily by PM USA using domestic and imported tobacco, and sold to wholesalers and large retail organizations in the United States. Production requires physical manufacturing facilities and regulated supply chains.

products.name: Machine-Made Large Cigars
products.description: Machine-made large cigars are produced by Middleton, primarily using tobacco sourced through third-party importers, and sold to U.S. customers. Manufacturing involves physical production and distribution through wholesalers and retailers.

products.name: Moist Smokeless Tobacco (MST) Products
products.description: Moist smokeless tobacco products are manufactured by USSTC using domestically sourced tobacco under contract growing programs, and sold to U.S. consumers under brands like Copenhagen and Skoal. Production involves physical processing and packaging of tobacco.

products.name: Oral Nicotine Pouches
products.description: Oral nicotine pouches, such as the on! brand, are manufactured by Helix using tobacco-derived nicotine materials and sold to U.S. consumers. These are non-tobacco, smoke-free products delivered through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: E-Vapor Products
products.description: E-vapor products, including devices and consumables, are manufactured by NJOY using imported components and nicotine materials, and sold to U.S. customers. These are regulated, smoke-free electronic nicotine delivery systems distributed through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Heated Tobacco Stick (HTS) Products
products.description: Heated tobacco stick products, to be marketed and commercialized by Horizon, combine a tobacco heating device and a consumable stick. Production involves device manufacturing (by JTIUH) and consumable manufacturing (by PM USA), pending FDA authorization for U.S. commercialization.

products.name: Senior and Unitranche Leveraged Loans
products.description: Provision of senior and unitranche leveraged loans to U.S. middle-market companies, typically secured by first or second lien on assets, with floating or fixed interest rates and structured amortization schedules. These loans are originated or acquired through direct lending or participation in loan syndicates.

products.name: Mezzanine Debt Financing
products.description: Provision of mezzanine debt to middle-market companies, typically unsecured and subordinated to senior debt, with fixed interest payments and longer maturities. These investments are used to finance ownership changes, acquisitions, recapitalizations, and growth initiatives.

products.name: Equity Investments in Middle-Market Companies
products.description: Equity investments, including preferred and common equity, in private U.S. middle-market companies, often as part of a group of private equity investors. These investments are generally not control-oriented and may include dividend-paying or non-dividend-paying securities.

products.name: Opportunistic Investments (Distressed Debt, Structured Finance, Joint Ventures)
products.description: Investments in a range of opportunistic assets, including distressed debt (such as securities of companies in bankruptcy), structured finance vehicles (e.g., collateralized loan obligation funds), joint ventures, foreign debt, and select public company securities. These are made to enhance returns and may comprise up to 30% of the portfolio.

products.name: Navenibart
products.description: A humanized monoclonal antibody inhibitor of plasma kallikrein, developed through hybridoma screening and antibody optimization, intended for chronic, preventative treatment of hereditary angioedema (HAE). Delivered via subcutaneous injection, with autoinjector and pre-filled syringe drug device combinations in development. Manufactured by third-party contract manufacturers under cGMP.

products.name: STAR-0310
products.description: A monoclonal antibody OX40 antagonist incorporating YTE half-life extension technology, developed for the treatment of moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (AD) and potentially other allergic and immunological diseases. Delivered via subcutaneous injection, manufactured by third-party contract manufacturers under cGMP.

products.name: Photovoltaic (PV) Solar Modules
products.description: Manufactured at the G1_Dallas facility in Texas, these modules use advanced PERC and TOPCon technologies and are produced for utility-scale, commercial & industrial (C&I), and residential applications. The modules are physically manufactured using automated assembly lines and are delivered as finished hardware products to customers.

products.name: Solar Cells
products.description: High-efficiency solar cells, primarily TOPCon technology, to be manufactured at the G2_Austin facility in Texas. These are physical components used in the assembly of PV solar modules and are produced through advanced manufacturing processes for integration into modules or potential sale to third parties.

products.name: Turnkey Solar and Battery Solutions
products.description: Integrated offerings that combine domestically manufactured PV solar modules and energy storage (battery) solutions, targeting utility and project development customers. Delivery involves physical products and potentially bundled services, leveraging advanced manufacturing and partnerships for battery technology.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides credit solutions including commercial and industrial loans, construction loans, investor commercial real estate loans, single tenant lease financing, and specialty finance (healthcare, franchise, equipment) to businesses nationwide. Delivered through relationship banking and strategic partnerships, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Small Business Lending
products.description: Offers a range of lending products to small businesses, including SBA 7(a) loans, through digital channels and partnerships, requiring financial capital and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Public and Municipal Finance
products.description: Provides lending and leasing products to governmental entities and acquires securities issued by state and local governments, delivered nationwide through a specialized subsidiary, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans, primarily originated nationwide through relationships with dealerships and financing partners, requiring financial capital and digital delivery infrastructure.

products.name: Deposit Products (Consumer and Small Business)
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit accounts, including checking and savings, to consumers and small businesses nationwide, delivered primarily through digital channels without traditional branches.

products.name: Commercial Deposit and Treasury Management Services
products.description: Offers deposit products and treasury management services to commercial and municipal customers, supporting business operations and cash management, delivered digitally and through relationship banking.

products.name: Fintech Banking Partnerships
products.description: Provides payment, deposit, card, and lending products and services through partnerships with financial technology companies and platforms, leveraging digital infrastructure and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Commerce Platform Subscriptions
products.description: Cloud-based, multi-channel commerce platform subscriptions enabling merchants to manage, market, and sell products online, in-store, and across various channels. Delivered digitally via SaaS with monthly or annual plans, including enterprise-grade Shopify Plus.

products.name: Point of Sale (POS) Solutions
products.description: Integrated POS software and hardware enabling merchants to process in-person sales in physical retail locations. Includes POS Pro subscriptions and the sale of POS hardware devices.

products.name: Payment Processing Services
products.description: Fully integrated payment processing and currency conversion services (Shopify Payments) for merchants, facilitating online and in-person transactions. Delivered via digital infrastructure and regulated financial technology.

products.name: Merchant Lending Services
products.description: Provision of working capital and lending solutions to merchants, enabling business growth and operations. Delivered digitally and subject to financial regulations.

products.name: Shipping and Fulfillment Solutions
products.description: Sale of shipping labels and related services to merchants, enabling streamlined order fulfillment and logistics. Delivered digitally through the platform and partnerships with carriers.

products.name: Domain Registration and Store Themes
products.description: Registration of domain names and sale of website themes to merchants for customizing their online storefronts. Delivered digitally via the Shopify platform.

products.name: App Marketplace
products.description: Marketplace for third-party and Shopify-developed apps that extend platform functionality for merchants. Apps are delivered digitally via the Shopify App Store.

products.name: Advertising and Buyer Acquisition Services
products.description: Advertising solutions and buyer acquisition offerings (e.g., Shop Campaigns) to help merchants attract and retain customers. Delivered digitally through the platform and partner channels.

products.name: Autonomous Trucking Services
products.description: A subscription-based service providing fully autonomous, driverless operation of Class 8 trucks for freight transport, delivered via the Aurora Driver platform integrated into partner-manufactured trucks. The service is deployed on high-volume, highway-focused routes and leverages physical hardware, proprietary software, and cloud-based updates.

products.name: Autonomous Ride Hailing Services
products.description: A subscription-based service enabling fully autonomous, driverless ride hailing for passenger mobility, using the Aurora Driver platform integrated into passenger vehicles. The service is delivered through partnerships with ride hailing networks and vehicle manufacturers, and includes digital software, hardware, and over-the-air updates.

products.name: Autonomous Local Goods Delivery Services
products.description: A service providing autonomous delivery of local goods, including last-mile parcel, post, prepared food, grocery, and B2B delivery, using the Aurora Driver platform integrated into various vehicle types. The service leverages digital software, proprietary hardware, and cloud-based updates to enable efficient and scalable delivery operations.

products.name: Aurora Driver Platform (Hardware and Software)
products.description: A common, modular autonomous driving platform consisting of proprietary hardware (including lidar, radar, and cameras) and software (AI, machine learning, mapping, and planning) that can be integrated into multiple vehicle types for commercial applications. Delivered as a subscription service, it includes regular software and map updates, and is supported by a partner ecosystem for maintenance and support.

products.name: Launch Services
products.description: Design, manufacture, and operation of small and medium-class orbital and suborbital rockets (Electron, HASTE, and Neutron) to deliver customer payloads to Earth orbit and interplanetary destinations. This involves physical manufacturing, regulated launch infrastructure, and in-person operations at dedicated launch complexes.

products.name: Spacecraft Manufacturing and Spacecraft-as-a-Service
products.description: Design, manufacture, and delivery of complete spacecraft (e.g., Photon family) for customer missions, including configuration for low Earth orbit, geosynchronous, and interplanetary missions. Includes mission operations and on-orbit management, leveraging in-house manufacturing and ground station infrastructure.

products.name: Spacecraft Components
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of spacecraft components such as composite structures, reaction wheels, star trackers, radios, separation systems, solar power solutions, command and control software, high voltage space-grade batteries, and optical systems to commercial and government customers. These are produced in-house and sold as merchant products for integration into customer spacecraft.

products.name: Optical Systems (EO/IR Payloads)
products.description: Development and manufacture of advanced electro-optical and infrared sensor payloads for national security space missions, including space domain awareness, missile tracking, and tactical intelligence. Delivered as compact hardware for satellites and ground-based surveillance systems.

products.name: Solar Power Solutions for Spacecraft
products.description: Design and manufacture of space-grade solar cells, coverglass interconnected cells (CICs), and solar array products for spacecraft power generation, supporting missions from low Earth orbit to interplanetary applications. Produced at dedicated facilities and sold to civil, defense, and commercial customers.

products.name: Flight and Ground Software Services
products.description: Provision of software solutions for spacecraft command, guidance, navigation, control, ground station interface, and ground data systems, enabling customer mission operations and integration with ground infrastructure. Delivered as digital products and services.

products.name: Spacecraft Engineering, Design, and Constellation Management Services
products.description: Engineering services for spacecraft development, design, and manufacturing, as well as on-orbit constellation management, including command and control operations and data delivery for customer satellite constellations. Involves technical consulting, mission operations, and leveraging ground station networks.

products.name: Industrial and Logistics Property Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of industrial and logistics properties, including buildings and leased industrial lands, to external tenants across the United States. Properties are physically owned or controlled, and leased under long-term agreements, with tenants responsible for most operating expenses. Delivery requires real estate acquisition, property management, and compliance with leasing regulations.

products.name: Wireless Systems Solutions
products.description: Integrated hardware and software solutions for advanced wireless communications, sensing, and detection, including products for 5G/mmWave communications, mmWave imaging, software defined radio, and custom RF integrated circuits. These are designed, prototyped, manufactured, and maintained for customers in defense, aerospace, commercial, and industrial sectors, and delivered as both products and design services.

products.name: Interconnect Products (EMI Filters and Connectors)
products.description: Manufactured electromagnetic interference (EMI) filter inserts and filtered/non-filtered connectors for aerospace, military, defense, and medical applications. These physical components are designed and produced in-house to reduce EMI and ensure signal integrity in mission-critical electronic systems.

products.name: Custom Sensing and Detection Modules and Services
products.description: Custom-designed mmWave and RF sensing modules and related design services for security, medical, and industrial applications. These solutions involve the design, prototyping, and system integration of multi-band, multi-spectral sensors for non-destructive testing, security screening, and medical diagnostics.

products.name: Microelectronics and mmWave Integrated Circuits (ICs)
products.description: Development and anticipated sale of semiconductor components, including application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), RFICs, and system-on-chip (SoC) ICs for wireless systems and devices. These are designed to minimize chip count and cost for mmWave wireless devices, with manufacturing outsourced to third-party wafer fabs.

products.name: HIV Therapies
products.description: Oral and injectable antiretroviral medicines, including single-tablet regimens and long-acting injectables, for the treatment and prevention (PrEP) of HIV-1 infection. These are manufactured through pharmaceutical processes and distributed globally via wholesalers and partners.

products.name: Liver Disease Therapies
products.description: Oral medications for the treatment of chronic hepatitis C (HCV), hepatitis B (HBV), and primary biliary cholangitis (PBC), produced via pharmaceutical manufacturing and distributed through global channels.

products.name: Oncology Therapies
products.description: Cell therapies (CAR T-cell), antibody-drug conjugates, and monoclonal antibodies for various cancers, including lymphomas, leukemia, and breast cancer, manufactured using advanced biologics and cell processing technologies and delivered via infusion in clinical settings.

products.name: COVID-19 Therapy
products.description: Intravenous antiviral medication for the treatment of COVID-19 in hospitalized and high-risk non-hospitalized patients, produced through pharmaceutical manufacturing and distributed to healthcare providers.

products.name: Antifungal Therapy
products.description: Liposomal injectable formulation of amphotericin B for the treatment of serious invasive fungal infections, manufactured using proprietary liposomal technology and distributed to hospitals and clinics.

products.name: Out-licensed Intellectual Property and Royalties
products.description: Licensing of intellectual property and receipt of royalties and other payments from third-party collaborations, involving legal agreements and ongoing management of IP rights.

products.name: Process and Material Handling Equipment and Systems
products.description: Designs, engineers, manufactures, and sells highly-engineered process and material handling equipment and integrated systems for industries such as plastics, food, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, minerals, energy, and recycling. Products include compounding, extrusion, conveying, mixing, ingredient automation, portioning, and screening/separating equipment, delivered as standalone machines or turnkey systems, requiring physical manufacturing and engineering expertise.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Services for Processing Equipment
products.description: Provides aftermarket parts, maintenance, repair, modernization, installation, consulting, and training services for installed process and material handling equipment and systems, leveraging a global network of service engineers and technicians. This business is supported by a large installed base and requires in-person technical labor and logistics.

products.name: Mixing, Ingredient Automation, and Portioning Equipment
products.description: Manufactures and sells mixing machines for solids and liquids, ingredient automation systems for bulk and micro ingredient handling, and portioning equipment for food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics industries. These are physical products requiring specialized engineering and manufacturing, delivered under various brands.

products.name: Screening and Separating Equipment
products.description: Designs and manufactures equipment that sorts dry, granular products by particle size for industries such as fertilizers, chemicals, plastics, and food processing. These are physical machines using proprietary motion technology, requiring manufacturing and engineering expertise.

products.name: Recycling Processing Solutions
products.description: Provides end-to-end recycling solutions including shredding, washing, separating, drying, agglomerating, bulk material handling, feeding, extrusion, compounding, and pelletizing for plastics recycling. Delivered as integrated systems or production lines, requiring physical manufacturing and process engineering.

products.name: Hot Runner and Process Control Systems for Injection Molding
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells highly-engineered hot runner and process control systems for the plastics injection molding industry. These systems are customized for each customer’s end product and require frequent replacement due to design changes, involving advanced engineering and manufacturing.

products.name: Mold Bases and Components
products.description: Manufactures and sells high-quality mold bases, plates, and components for injection molding applications, available in various configurations and pre-engineered assemblies. These are physical products requiring precision manufacturing and engineering.

products.name: Aftermarket Parts and Services for Molding Equipment
products.description: Provides aftermarket parts, maintenance, repair, rebuilds, consulting, and training services for hot runner systems, mold bases, and other molding equipment, supported by a global network of service engineers and technicians. This business leverages the installed base and requires in-person technical labor.

products.name: Maintenance, Repair, and Operating (MRO) Supplies for Molding Industry
products.description: Supplies maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) products for the plastic technology processing industry, supporting ongoing operations of molding equipment. These are physical consumables and replacement items sold to external customers.

products.name: ExtraCash
products.description: A short-term credit product offered through bank partners, providing members with up to $500 in discretionary overdraft via a fully digital, automated process using proprietary AI underwriting. Funds are delivered digitally through the mobile app, with a transparent fee structure and no interest or credit checks.

products.name: Dave Checking
products.description: A digital demand deposit account with no account minimums or fees, FDIC pass-through insurance, and access to a virtual or physical Dave Debit Card. Accounts are opened and managed via the mobile app, with funds accessible for everyday purchases and ATM withdrawals.

products.name: Personal Financial Management Tools
products.description: A suite of digital tools within the Dave app, including budgeting, savings automation (Goals), and cash flow prediction, designed to help members manage finances, anticipate expenses, and automate savings. Delivered entirely through the mobile platform.

products.name: Side Hustle Job Portal
products.description: A digital job application portal within the Dave app that connects members to supplemental, gig economy, part-time, seasonal, remote, and flexible employment opportunities. Delivered as an integrated feature in the mobile platform.

products.name: Private Label Credit Card Programs
products.description: Atlanticus, through its technology platform and bank partners, enables private label credit card programs for retail and healthcare partners, branded as Fortiva and Curae, delivered via physical and digital channels and tailored to specific merchant needs. These programs require integration with retailer and healthcare provider infrastructure and are supported by proprietary analytics and instant decisioning technology.

products.name: General Purpose Credit Card Programs
products.description: Atlanticus manages and supports general purpose credit card programs, including Mercury, Aspire, Imagine, and Fortiva brands, for near-prime and underserved consumers, leveraging its technology and analytics to enable instant credit decisions and tailored offers. These cards are originated by bank partners and delivered through multiple channels, with Atlanticus acquiring the receivables and managing servicing.

products.name: Auto Loan Purchasing and Servicing
products.description: Through its CAR subsidiary, Atlanticus purchases and services loans secured by automobiles from independent automotive dealers, primarily in the buy-here, pay-here used car market, and provides related servicing and risk management. The company earns revenue from interest, discount accretion, and servicing fees, and manages dealer relationships and loan performance.

products.name: Floor-Plan Financing for Auto Dealers
products.description: Atlanticus provides floor-plan financing to independent automotive dealers, enabling them to finance their inventory purchases. This service is delivered through the CAR subsidiary and is part of the broader auto finance segment, requiring financial capital and risk management infrastructure.

products.name: Loan Servicing and Customer Service Outsourcing
products.description: Atlanticus offers loan servicing, risk management, and customer service outsourcing for third-party lenders, leveraging its technology platform and operational infrastructure to process payments, manage customer communications, and resolve disputes. This service is provided both for its own receivables and as a fee-based service for external clients.

products.name: Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD) Exon Skipping Therapies
products.description: A portfolio of clinical-stage oligonucleotide-based genetic medicines (ENTR-601-44, ENTR-601-45, ENTR-601-50, ENTR-601-51) designed to treat DMD by promoting exon skipping and restoring dystrophin production. These are manufactured using proprietary EEV peptide conjugation and delivered via intravenous infusion.

products.name: Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1 (DM1) Therapy (VX-670)
products.description: A partnered oligonucleotide-based therapy (VX-670) for DM1, designed to correct RNA splicing defects by targeting toxic CUG repeats. Developed and manufactured using EEV peptide conjugation technology, with Vertex responsible for global development and commercialization.

products.name: Inherited Retinal Disease Therapies (Ocular Genetic Medicines)
products.description: A pipeline of oligonucleotide-based therapies for inherited retinal diseases, including ENTR-801 for Usher syndrome type 2A (USH2A) and a second candidate in development. These are designed for local ocular delivery to restore protein function in photoreceptors, using proprietary EEV technology.

products.name: Enzyme Replacement Therapy for MNGIE (PTI-501)
products.description: An EEV-enzyme conjugate (PTI-501) for mitochondrial neurogastrointestinal encephalomyopathy (MNGIE), designed to deliver enzymes intracellularly to correct metabolic deficiencies. Licensed to Pierrepont Therapeutics, Inc. after IND-enabling studies.

products.name: Generic Prescription Drugs
products.description: Pharmaceutically equivalent versions of brand-name drugs across multiple therapeutic areas, manufactured by international partners and sold primarily in Canada under Nora Pharma or partner labels. Products are sourced via in-licensing, cross-licensing, and distribution agreements, and require regulatory approval from Health Canada.

products.name: Over-the-Counter (OTC) Supplements
products.description: Non-prescription health supplements, including proprietary and in-licensed products, manufactured under contract and sold primarily through online marketplaces such as Amazon in Canada. Products include amino acid blends, vitamins, and other nutraceuticals, requiring regulatory approval (NPN) from Health Canada.

products.name: Proprietary Oncology Therapeutics (in development)
products.description: Novel anti-cancer drugs, including mRNA-based therapies (e.g., K1.1 mRNA-LNP), developed using advanced biotechnology and currently in preclinical animal testing. These are not yet marketed but are intended for future commercialization pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Proprietary Antiviral Therapeutics (in development)
products.description: Small molecule drugs targeting coronavirus proteases (e.g., SBFM-PL4), developed through internal R&D and academic partnerships, currently in preclinical stages. These are intended for treatment of SARS-CoV-2 and related infections, with plans for future commercialization.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Distribution
products.description: Wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical products, including import and export of a wide range of drugs for various health indications such as cancer therapies, ADHD, multiple sclerosis, and anti-depressants. This is conducted primarily through physical logistics and regulated infrastructure, anchored by the subsidiary Phatebo in Germany.

products.name: Digital Asset Treasury Management
products.description: Management of a treasury reserve primarily allocated to cryptocurrency holdings, especially 0G and other blockchain-linked cryptocurrencies, including purchasing, holding, staking, and compounding digital assets to generate returns. This is a capital-intensive, digital-only activity involving blockchain infrastructure and regulated custody solutions.

products.name: AI-Focused Asset Management
products.description: Investment and asset management services focused on the AI sector, including strategic ownership in AI-related tokens (such as 0G), investments in compute power technology companies, and fee-earning opportunities on capital deployed in the AI ecosystem. This involves financial capital allocation and digital asset management.

products.name: Earthquake Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for residential and commercial properties against earthquake-related damages, including home damage, contents, appurtenant structures, and business interruption. Offered on both admitted and E&S basis, leveraging proprietary data analytics and catastrophe models for pricing and underwriting. Delivered through agents, brokers, and program administrators.

products.name: Casualty Insurance
products.description: Specialty insurance products covering various casualty risks, including E&S Casualty, Primary Casualty, Real Estate Agent Errors and Omissions, Excess Liability, Environmental Liability, and Surety coverages. Offered on admitted and E&S basis, with underwriting supported by actuarial analysis and experienced underwriters. Distributed through brokers and program administrators.

products.name: Inland Marine and Other Property Insurance
products.description: Insurance products covering inland marine, Hawaii hurricane, excess national property, residential flood, and other property risks. Written on both admitted and E&S basis, targeting both personal and commercial customers, with flexible policy limits and risk-based pricing. Distributed via agents, brokers, and program administrators.

products.name: Crop Insurance
products.description: Multi-peril crop insurance products, including coverage for revenue shortfalls or production losses due to natural causes (drought, hail, wind), as well as livestock and private product crop solutions. Offered in partnership with the USDA's Risk Management Agency and through private products, with exposure managed geographically. Delivered via agents and program administrators.

products.name: Surety Bonds
products.description: Surety products including contract bonds for small, mid-sized, and emerging contractors, primarily in construction. Provided through acquired subsidiaries and specialized surety carriers, licensed nationwide, and distributed via agents and brokers. Involves underwriting of contractor obligations and risk transfer to the insurer.

products.name: Fronting Services
products.description: Fronting arrangements where the company issues insurance policies on behalf of other insurers, reinsurers, or managing general agents who lack required licensure or ratings. The company provides its licensed admitted and E&S insurance platforms to enable customized insurance programs, earning fee income and ceding risk to partners. Delivered through carrier and program administrator partnerships.

products.name: Asian Food and Non-Alcoholic Beverage Distribution
products.description: Sourcing, importing, and distributing a wide range of Asian food products and non-alcoholic beverages (including frozen foods, dry groceries, snacks, and specialty drinks) to wholesalers, grocery stores, and warehouse clubs in the U.S. Products are sourced from reputable suppliers in Asia and delivered through a robust logistics and distribution network, including both ambient and temperature-controlled logistics.

products.name: Food and Beverage Supply Chain Management Services
products.description: Providing B2B supply chain management solutions for food and beverage businesses, including logistics coordination, customs and regulatory compliance, warehousing, cross-border trade facilitation, and technology integration. Services are delivered via a digital platform and involve both physical and digital infrastructure to streamline sourcing, purchasing, and delivery processes.

products.name: Food and Beverage Brand Management Services
products.description: Offering brand management solutions for food and beverage companies, including brand marketing strategy, promotional planning, product placement, sales evaluation, and document processing. Services are provided by experienced professionals and leverage digital tools for tracking and analytics.

products.name: Supply Chain Consulting Services
products.description: Providing consulting services to optimize supply chain processes for food and beverage businesses, including process assessments, efficiency improvements, and cost-saving strategies. Delivered by supply chain experts through direct client engagement and customized solutions.

products.name: Indoor Home Improvement Product Distribution
products.description: Sourcing, importing, and distributing a range of indoor home improvement products—including kitchen cabinets, countertops, flooring, kitchen sinks, and related materials—to homeowners, interior designers, and dealers. Products are sourced from international suppliers (primarily Vietnam), sold through a physical showroom and online, and delivered as prefabricated, ready-to-assemble units with optional assembly services.

products.name: Expedition Cruises
products.description: Ship-based expedition cruises to remote and exotic destinations worldwide, operated on a fleet of small, customized vessels equipped for exploration and guided by expert staff. These cruises include all accommodations, meals, and activities, and are delivered through both owned and chartered ships.

products.name: Land-Based Nature and Wildlife Adventures
products.description: Small-group, conservation-focused land tours and safaris centered on wildlife viewing, nature immersion, and cultural experiences, often with exclusive access to private reserves, remote parks, and unique lodges. Delivered through brands like Natural Habitat and Thomson Group, these trips emphasize sustainability and expert local guiding.

products.name: Luxury Walking Tours
products.description: Curated, small-group and private walking tours in over 50 countries, featuring immersive cultural and historical experiences led by expert local guides, with boutique accommodations and handcrafted itineraries. Delivered primarily through the Classic Journeys brand.

products.name: Luxury Cycling Tours
products.description: Guided luxury bike tours in destinations worldwide, focusing on cultural immersion, culinary experiences, and boutique accommodations, with support vehicles and top-quality bikes. Delivered through the DuVine Cycling + Adventure Company brand.

products.name: Active Small-Group and Custom Adventure Tours
products.description: Active, immersive small-group and private custom journeys featuring hiking, walking, wildlife, and cultural experiences in unique geographies, with a focus on authentic lodging and local guides. Delivered through Off the Beaten Path and similar brands.

products.name: Kilimanjaro Treks and Mountain Expeditions
products.description: Guided treks and expeditions to Mount Kilimanjaro and other mountain destinations, including luxury and custom options, with experienced guides and specialized support. Delivered through Thomson Group brands such as Nature Discovery.

products.name: Lodge Accommodation Services
products.description: High-end lodge accommodations in unique natural settings, such as Gibb’s Farm near Ngorongoro Crater, offered as part of safari and adventure itineraries or as standalone stays.

products.name: Treg-Enhancing Biologics (including COYA 302, COYA 303, COYA 301)
products.description: Proprietary biologic drugs designed to enhance regulatory T cell (Treg) function, delivered via subcutaneous injection. These include single-agent (COYA 301) and combination biologics (COYA 302: low-dose IL-2 + CTLA4-Ig; COYA 303: low-dose IL-2 + GLP-1 RA), manufactured using biotechnological processes for treatment of neurodegenerative, autoimmune, and metabolic diseases.

products.name: Treg-Derived Exosome Therapeutics (including COYA 201, COYA 206)
products.description: Therapeutic products based on exosomes derived from regulatory T cells, manufactured via expansion and conversion of Tregs, and delivered intravenously or intranasally. These exosomes are nanosized vesicles carrying anti-inflammatory signals, developed for use in neurodegenerative, autoimmune, and metabolic diseases.

products.name: Autologous Treg Cell Therapy
products.description: Cell therapy using a patient's own regulatory T cells, expanded and processed ex vivo, then re-administered to restore immunomodulatory function. Requires specialized cell manufacturing and cryopreservation processes for chronic dosing.

products.name: Integrated Human Capital Management (HCM) Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based platforms that unify payroll, HR management, benefits, talent management, workforce management, and analytics for businesses of all sizes. Delivered via SaaS platforms such as RUN Powered by ADP, ADP Workforce Now, and ADP Lyric HCM, these solutions are accessed digitally and supported by service teams.

products.name: Payroll Services
products.description: Comprehensive payroll processing and administration, including paycheck preparation, tax filings, electronic payments, and compliance reporting. Services are delivered through cloud platforms and can be integrated with ERP systems or fully outsourced.

products.name: Benefits Administration
products.description: Cloud-based solutions for administering employee benefits, including health and welfare, leave, insurance carrier enrollment, and dependent verification. Delivered digitally with support for employee self-service and employer compliance.

products.name: Talent Management Solutions
products.description: Digital tools and services for talent acquisition, recruitment process outsourcing, performance management, learning, succession, compensation management, and employee engagement. Delivered via cloud platforms and supported by analytics and consulting.

products.name: Workforce Management Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based and mobile-enabled solutions for time and attendance, absence management, scheduling, labor forecasting, and workforce analytics. Includes hardware (timeclocks) and software for automating labor tracking and compliance.

products.name: Compliance Solutions
products.description: Expertise and technology for employment-related compliance, including tax services, W-2 management, business tax credits, I-9 management, employment verification, wage garnishment, and paycard solutions. Delivered as add-ons to core HCM and payroll services.

products.name: Human Resources Management Solutions (HRIS)
products.description: Cloud-based systems for managing employee data, job history, compensation, and HR records. Delivered as part of integrated HCM platforms, enabling centralized HR data management and reporting.

products.name: Insurance Services
